children: Duluth Holdings Inc. reported results for the 13-week second quarter ended Aug. 2, 2026, with revenue of $121.4M and net income attributable to controlling interest of $18.4M, or diluted EPS of $0.5, versus $131.7M revenue and $1.3M net income (EPS $0.04) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $121.4M for Q2 FY2026, down from $131.7M in the year-ago quarter (7.8%).
Net income attributable to controlling interest was $18.4M for Q2 FY2026, up from $1.3M in the year-ago quarter (1,324%).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.50 for Q2 FY2026, up from $0.04 in the year-ago quarter.

Net sales declined roughly 7.8% for the quarter and 6.2% year-to-date, driven by weaker direct-to-consumer web traffic and lower web conversion; higher average order values partially offset direct-to-consumer weakness.
Reduced promotional activity supported improved margins; gross margin improved materially due in part to tariff refunds and sourcing benefits — ex-refund Q2 margin was about 59.6%.
Operationally, the company closed its Salt Lake City fulfillment center, recording related impairment and restructuring charges while realizing fulfillment cost leverage.
Tariff refunds and stronger operating cash helped liquidity, though the company expects continued macro uncertainty to pressure demand.
